authorization: 2026-10-21 user requested 3 or 5 seeds; execute total 3: reference 43 and fresh 44,45
question: With few newly labelled attack examples, compare cumulative XGB retraining against frozen TabPFN with cumulative or 1000-row contexts
correction: Reduce the supplied per-class sample counts themselves; admit every supplied row. Remove admission caps, class quotas, selection experiments, and the ICD pilot.
historical_100_rationale: Presentation example among explored budgets; not a statistical median, optimum, empirical minimum, or operationally justified quota
budget_rationale: User-approved sweep 5/10/20/30/50/100. At n=100 the largest ToN stage admits 200 rows (20% of B=1000); no incoming row is rejected.

admission.rule: Admit ALL supplied new rows at every stage, exactly k_t*n; no cap or rejection

class_retention.source: Unchanged EXP83 deletion rule; no new 500/25 quota or balancing

eviction.fifo: Unchanged EXP83: oldest acquisition order, retain the original within-stage ordering; skip only the last remaining row of a class
eviction.random: seed + zero-based stage_index * 1009 permutation; identical deletion rule otherwise
eviction.similar: Unchanged EXP83: minimum Euclidean distance to any incoming row after StandardScaler fitted on OLD context only; stable tie order; skip only last class rows
eviction.common: Delete exactly as many OLD rows as arrive, then append every incoming row. Never retrieve evicted rows.

sampling: Same select_initial and 100-row per-class incoming-pool sampling as reference; subset_plans produces nested n per seed. Verify seed 43 reproduces every reference incoming ID and row order. Seeds 44 and 45 change initial/incoming IDs and model random_state; test split/order/panel fixed to seed 43.

model.checkpoint: same recorded TabPFN v3 checkpoint as EXP83

evaluation.main: Final state on complete fixed held-out test, identical mixed order and query batch 8192
evaluation.stage_panel: Seed-43 sample of up to 2000 fixed-test rows per class; fixed ID list and fixed label-independent query order across all stages; labels used only for sampling and metrics
evaluation.panel_queries: The same fixed panel may include future-class query features; no query labels enter fitting, context selection, preprocessing or admission; unknown-class detection is not scored
evaluation.stage_known_metrics: Confusion matrix for rows of currently introduced classes, with label-set mapping explicit
evaluation.paired_old_retention: For update t, compare model states t-1 and t on exactly the same fixed panel rows from classes known before t; use the same old-class evaluation population for both scores
evaluation.joint_false_positives: Also report per-class precision/F1 from the full currently-known population, including newly introduced classes; old-only F1 does not include new-to-old false positives
evaluation.new_metrics: Per-class recall/F1 for just-introduced and all post-initial attack classes; full currently-known population supplies false positives
diagnostics: fixed original-class panel score through all stages
evaluation.interpretation: Three-seed exploratory evidence on a previously inspected fixed test; no statistical equivalence or minimum-label guarantee
evaluation.stage_panel_role: Offline post-hoc evaluation of saved stage models, not a causal temporal replay

cost.primary: GPU-synchronized wall time for context assembly/eviction + model construction + preprocessing + cumulative XGB fit or PFN cache preparation, summed after initial stage
cost.measurement: Sequential GPU runs on the same RTX 4090 and package versions; seed 43 reused from Oct20, fresh seeds 44/45 on Oct21; log warm-up policy and disclose cross-session variation
cost.cache_note: Every new row is admitted. Replacing even a few rows may rebuild the entire 1000-row context cache; fixed capacity does not imply incremental or free updates.
cost.historical: Keep seed43 measurements unchanged. Compare methods within the same seed/session, then report mean/sample-SD across matched seed pairs; do not pair an old PFN time with a new XGB time.

icd_reference.basis: Paper Section 3 objective, Figure 2 gradient flow, Section 4 optimization settings
icd_reference.author_implementation: No author-released ICD code verified in this review; do not claim use of official code
icd_reference.provenance: Local v3 adaptation of the paper idea, not author code or a verified faithful reproduction
icd_reference.discussion: Optimizing context features requires gradient computation and addresses compression, not the present question of how few actual new labelled rows suffice. Reference only; no pilot in this design.

planned_outputs: final full-test overall and new-attack mean per-class F1 versus n
paired old-class changes on fixed panel
per-class metrics and context counts as supporting tables
execution: Reuse immutable completed seed43 reference; freshly run updates and final full-test predictions for 120 conditions across seeds44/45. Validate each complete seed; automatically aggregate mean/sample-SD and write Korean LaTeX/log at completion or failure.

aggregation.mean: arithmetic mean over seed-level metrics per dataset/n/method
aggregation.sd: sample SD ddof=1; absent with one seed
aggregation.paired_comparison: Within-seed difference versus cumulative XGB, then mean and sample SD
aggregation.scope: Fixed train/test split; variations in selected training rows, model randomness and random eviction jointly
aggregation.inference: No equivalence/significance claim from 3 repetitions; previously inspected fixed test remains exploratory
aggregation.cost: Identical scope; sequential GPU jobs. Reference seed measured Oct20, new seeds Oct21; cross-session timing variation disclosed

reference_preservation: Do not modify seed43 results, Oct20 report, CSV or figures. New aggregation uses exp84_multiseed_* files and Oct21 report.
automatic_reporting: Korean docs/lablog/reports/20261021_exp84.tex and one line log; temporary PDF compile; no automatic slides/manuscript changes
